title: Senior Computer Vision & Robotics Perception Engineer
text:
Kestrel Autonomy builds autonomous mobile manipulation and material-handling robots that operate alongside human crews in high-throughput logistics hubs. Our robots rely on onboard vision, depth, and range sensors to perceive crowded aisles, localize within millimeter tolerances, and operate safely 24/7.

We are seeking a Senior Computer Vision & Robotics Perception Engineer to lead our 3D scene understanding and edge deployment stack. You will own perception models from dataset curation and distributed training in PyTorch through INT8 compilation on embedded NVIDIA Jetson compute modules running on the robot fleet.

Responsibilities:
- Design and train deep learning models for 2D/3D object detection, semantic segmentation, and multi-object tracking in PyTorch.
- Optimize deep neural networks via quantization, pruning, and TensorRT compilation for real-time edge inference on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
- Develop production Robot Operating System middleware nodes, custom message transports, and real-time C++ perception pipelines.
- Architect multi-sensor calibration and state-estimation fusion across LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, and IMU sensors.
- Maintain centimeter-level robot localization across large-scale indoor environments without external motion-capture infrastructure.
- Build active learning loops and automated hard-negative mining pipelines to curate high-value training data from fleet logs.
- Validate perception and obstacle avoidance changes in closed-loop simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim or Gazebo.
- Lead root-cause debugging of field robotics failures and coordinate cross-functional triage across hardware, firmware, and autonomy teams.

Nice to Have:
- Experience with neural radiance fields (NeRF) or 3D Gaussian Splatting for photorealistic scene reconstruction.
- Experience with end-to-end imitation learning or reinforcement learning for dexterous robotic arm manipulation.
